limitations_for_wp4_mechanics: Adding an axis link requires passing the EXISTING axis id (with expectedVersion = its current version, 1) inside reconcile_topic; a link-only patch is additive via ON CONFLICT upsert (linkRepository store.ts:5783, 5796-5800).

Person reuse: reconcile_topic.axes[].people[] goes through resolvePersonForLink; a person with nakamaUserId null is matched by github_login ('ajegorovs') or, when unique, by display_name (store.ts:6362-6410). Supplying neither would CREATE a second person with the same name only when no exact display_name match exists; with the existing row present the name-only path reuses it (unique). The account mapping (nakamaUserId) is still absent, so attributable stays false.

Problem repo links: reconcile_topic.problems[] with an existing problemId runs updateProblem and calls replaceProblemRepositories (store.ts:4845-4848) -> it REPLACES the problem's repository set, so the exact intended repositoryFullNames set must be sent; the manifest requires 'statement' on every problems[] item, so the verbatim statement must be echoed.
Problem state cannot be changed through problems[] on an update (store.ts:5931-5938); only via transitions[]. Not needed for these links.
reconcile_topic is per-topic atomic; adding infra axis links for topic 'Research infrastructure / team management' is one transaction in that topic.

Event->problem evidence (F14a) is a SEPARATE, supported but not-yet-used capability (reconcile_topic.activities[].problemId); the current fixture has zero event->problem links. Whether to add evidence links in addition to repository links is a WP4 decision, not part of this delta.
F09b: the repository model carries no pin field, so the dashboard pin cannot be stored as first-class repository state; it rides the evidence manifest only.
uncertainty: Axis-level repository attribution for the two infra axes rests on topic primary repo + commit provenance, not an explicit axis line in the seed packet ('product shared').
The axis-6 person link (D4) has no axis-local event; basis is topic membership + the recording commit's authorship.

D1/D2 relationship value is null/undecided (NOT 'supporting', NOT 'primary'): a fixture default or another fixture link does not establish the semantics, and a one-primary promotion is not source-established. Left to WP4/human.
